description: A large camel with a covered litter on its back, the litter bristling with arrows, stands in the middle of a dusty battle. Armored men in mail and turbans, some with round shields and swords, press in around it. A fallen figure lies at the bottom edge. Behind them is a hazy skyline of low buildings, minarets and palm trees under a dark smoky sky. The painting fills the frame with no text or border.
